text: Establishing a healthy root system demands that watering takes priority in any cultivation plan. Pruning follows immediately to excise dead or frail limbs while stimulating vigorous new development. Nutrient delivery then becomes the next requirement to sustain peak physiological function. Regular maintenance cuts are finally needed to preserve form and ensure air flows freely, thereby reducing risks of infestation or illness. Adherence to these basic protocols results in a lush, productive garden space.
